<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919915_theRebbe_134" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919915_theRebbe_134__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that through the soul illuminating the body, specifically where the choice of Atzmus resides, an elevation is added to the soul, and concludes with a prayer for the fulfillment of the prophecy of the resurrection and the coming of Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And likewise is it also regarding Yisrael themselves,</t>
    <t s="1">that through the soul illuminating the body,</t>
    <t s="2">in which</t>
    <t s="3">(specifically)</t>
    <t s="4">is the choice of Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="5">an elevation is added to the soul,</t>
    <t s="6">and analogous to the future era when the soul will be nourished from the body.</t>
    <t s="7">And may it be His will that very soon the prophecy be fulfilled,</t>
    <t s="8">"And they shall awaken and sing, you who dwell in the dust," and the master of the hillula among them,</t>
    <t s="9">and we will all go speedily, upright, to our land, with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu,</t>
    <t s="10">speedily, in our very own time.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
